id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

description.description: An description of what kind of validation checks this rule performs.

ruleset.description: The ruleset this rule belongs to.

action.description:
Target action that performs the validation required for this rule.
This function must take in an argument `args`, which is specified by the rule's {@link DataValidationRuleset#argSpec}.
All other arguments must be specified in this field directly.
This function returns any violations of the rule in the form of {@link DataValidationRuleResult}(s) (single entity or list are both okay).
It should return an empty list if the rule is not violated in any way.

targetType.description: The type that this rule primarily deals with. Only used for display/informational purposes.

inactive.description: Whether or not this rule is active and executed when the associated ruleset is run.

doNotBatch.description:
Whether or not this rule should be batched with other rules to be run sequentially and synchronously.
For rules which are known to take a long time, this field should be true.

possibleOutputs.description: Represents possible outputs of  the {@link DataValidationRule#ruleset}.

title:
A single rule for data validation. Typically corresponds to one desired property of one type. The main type which
users will seed/create in their application to define data model validation logic.
name: DataValidationRule
